closed: ∀ {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (M : Matroid α) (hrank : M.eRank = 3) (e f : α) (he : e ∈ M.E) (hf : f ∈ M.E) (hef : e ≠ f) (x : α → ℝ) (hx : ∀ a ∈ M.E, 0 < x a), 0 ≤ MvPolynomial.eval x (x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference (x2611_15512_set_polynomial M.Indep) e f)
original:
For every rank- $3$ matroid $M$ , every pair of distinct elements $e,f$ 
and every $x>0$ , $(\Delta_{e,f}I_{M})(x)\geq 0$ .
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] (M : Matroid α), M.eRank = 3 → ∀ (e f : α), e ∈ M.E → f ∈ M.E → e ≠ f → ∀ (x : α → ℝ), (∀ a ∈ M.E, 0 < x a) → 0 ≤ (MvPolynomial.eval x) (Mathlib2.x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference (Mathlib2.x2611_15512_set_polynomial M.Indep) e f)
